the California coast near Santa Cruz

Artichoke hearts dipped in a light sparkling water batter and fried crisp, salted and served hot with a lemon and garlic aioli for dunking. Drain 2 jars (about 560g) marinated artichoke hearts, halve and pat very dry. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour, a pinch of salt and 180ml ice-cold sparkling water into a light batter. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the artichokes and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain and salt. Stir 1 grated garlic clove, the zest of a lemon and 1 tbsp juice into 150g whole egg mayonnaise for the aioli.
Two identical stacks per person on each side of the plate: cracker, sharp cheddar, thin apple slice and a dot of fig jam, mirrored exactly.

Creamy clam and potato chowder with smoky bacon and thyme, ladled into hollowed sourdough cobs with the lids toasted on the side for dipping. Steam 1.5kg vongole in 250ml water for 4 minutes, pick the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 200g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then the clam liquid, 400ml milk, 500g diced potato and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes, add 250ml cream and the clams and warm through. Cut the tops off 4 small sourdough cobs, hollow them out, toast the lids and bowls at 200C for 8 minutes, and fill with chowder.

s.note: the boardwalk where it began in 1986
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard.
Build stacks of cracker, a slice of sharp cheddar, a thin apple slice and a dot of fig jam, using 200g cheddar and 2 apples. Put two identical stacks on each side of every plate, mirrored exactly.

m.note: the friends' fancy holiday house down the road
m.how: Grill 1kg chicken thighs and 4 corn cobs over coals, brushing the chicken with 150ml barbecue sauce in the last minutes. Shred a quarter cabbage with mayo. Serve with 4 soft rolls.

w.note: the white rabbits in the tunnels, left well alone
w.how: Mix 300g grated carrot, 100g walnuts, 200ml oil, 200g brown sugar, 3 eggs, cinnamon and nutmeg. Fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Frost with 250g cream cheese, 200g icing sugar and lemon zest.

d.note: the long line of hands across the country in 1986
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with ice. Add 60ml grenadine and top with 750ml lemonade. Float orange slices on top and hold hands while you drink it.
